WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    transaction_count,
    CAST(transaction_count AS REAL) / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM type_counts
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  s.tradekind,
  s.transaction_count,
  s.share,
  s.share - a.average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE a.average_share IS NOT NULL
  AND s.share > a.average_share;
